name: corpus.build20
description: DRAFT — 20-question build-priority rating for Recall BUILD_OUT cards. Extends corpus.card with build economics: determinism ceiling, runner fit, time-to-value, reuse, revenue proximity, proof-ability, maintenance, risk. State carries CARD_TITLE and CARD_SOURCE. Scores are consumed by code for ranking; only typed judgments are asked here.

lane_fit.instructions: Which RIG lane does this card primarily serve? Pick the one lane where the card's claim would be acted on this quarter.

criteria.rig_build: RIG OS, agents, harnesses, Memory OS, model routing
criteria.gtm_buyer: RIG B2B marketing, sales, outreach, pipeline
criteria.client: work landing on a client's account/reputation
criteria.jacob: content about Mike's 15-year-old son — CHILD LANE, sensitive
criteria.general: cross-cutting or none of the above

rig_overlap.instructions: How much does this card overlap with a RIG capability, skill, doctrine, or routine that already exists?

criteria.novel: at least one named claim is new to RIG
criteria.partial: extends an existing capability with new evidence
criteria.duplicate: core claim already stated in a RIG asset

evidence_density.instructions: How concrete is the card's evidence?

criteria.practitioner_argument: named person, named thesis, with reasons

actionability.instructions: What is the cheapest action that captures this card's value tonight?

criteria.extract_skill: a new SKILL.md can be authored tonight
criteria.doctrine_update: an existing file should be patched

anti_generic_force.instructions: How far does this card deviate from median AI/business advice? 0 = pure median, 3 = named mechanism not seen elsewhere, 5 = category-defining.

determinism_ceiling.instructions: On the L0-L5 determinism ladder, what is the MOST deterministic level this build could run at without quality loss? A task left at L4 that could be L1 is a bug.

criteria.script: L0-L1: deterministic script or orchestrated flow, no model judgment at runtime
criteria.typed_call: L2: one bounded typed model call consumed by code
criteria.bounded_agent: L3: bounded agent with fixed tools and stop conditions

runner_fit.instructions: Where should this build live if shipped? Browser-bound work (needs signed-in session) stays on Aside; cloud runners cannot hold a browser session.

criteria.aside_browser: Aside browser routine (needs signed-in web session)
criteria.local_script: local script/launchd on Mike's Mac, no browser

browser_dependency.instructions: Does executing this build require a signed-in browser session (LinkedIn, Airtable UI, web apps)?

time_to_first_value.instructions: How long from starting the build to first usable output?

reuse_frequency.instructions: Once built, how often would it actually run or be used?

revenue_proximity.instructions: How close is this build to money: a paying client, a sale, a job offer, or billable RIG output?

criteria.direct: directly produces revenue or a deliverable a buyer pays for
criteria.indirect: feeds a revenue lane within one hop

proof_ability.instructions: Can a done-claim for this build bind to command output, a file path, or a read-back (not an adjective)?

maintenance_cost.instructions: Ongoing cost to keep this build working (site changes, API drift, retraining)?

credential_need.instructions: What access does this build need?

criteria.new_account: needs a new external account or paid API

gate_d_risk.instructions: Does this build's OUTPUT touch the outside world: posts, messages, client accounts, money, or a minor?

jev_route_fit.instructions: Does this build create typed judgments (classification/routing/triage with a fixed answer set) that Jev can own instead of a frontier model?

doctrine_alignment.instructions: How does this card sit against existing RIG doctrine (skills, AGENTS.md, operating plans)?

criteria.extends: adds a new but compatible capability
criteria.contradicts: conflicts with a standing rule or duplicates a frozen lane

content_sufficiency.instructions: Is the card's content (title + source + what a builder would find at that source) enough to author the skill/build tonight, or does it need more research?

output_durability.instructions: Does the build produce a durable asset (skill, corpus, tool) or an ephemeral result?

build_confidence.instructions: Overall: how confident are you this card deserves one of 20 build slots this week? 0 = no, 3 = probably, 5 = certain.

rules.reason: conflicts with standing doctrine; human decides

notes.bar: Ranking stays in code: composite = 2*build_confidence + anti_generic_force + bonuses (novel, specific_code/pattern, extract_skill, daily reuse, direct revenue, high proof, low maintenance, durable) minus penalties (duplicate, weeks, high maintenance, new_account, sensitive, contradicts). Verdicts are advisory until calibrated.
notes.provenance: Drafted 2026-10-02 in Aside session hVEWSCC2We8MRSPx for the Recall build-out top-20 ranking, extending corpus.card with build economics from Mike's runner-selection + determinism doctrine.
